contract: Shared metadata policy verifies root, logs and state before read/write/chmod or job.
Absent status is read-only and returns initial state.
Output uses private temporary, fsync and rename; state path is checked again before publication.
Failed rename preserves previous bytes and cleans its own temporary.
limits: Same-user concurrent edits or concurrent scheduler status writers are not serialized or defended.
No new native boot or VM fixture run; real host filesystem/CLI plus synthetic job used.
Shared metadata rejects links/types/owner/special bits; does not authenticate JSON contents.
